shared_design_system.design_language: Constructive confrontation: honest but fair, nice but firm; bold UK-local-business editorial aesthetic; challenge complacency without demeaning business owners.

typography.heading: heavy geometric sans, approximate Arial Black/Inter Tight Black; match reference visually
typography.body: clean sans such as Inter, 16px desktop
typography.accent: handwritten italic brush only when pictured; do not use for body

implementation_notes: Reference screenshots are not literal copy or a source of exact CSS dimensions.
Build text and UI as HTML/CSS, not screenshot slices.
Crop files labeled reference are low-resolution guides and contain baked-in UI/text; replace with clean source imagery or rebuilt UI.
Do not invent customer testimonials, growth metrics, client names, business endorsements or platform features. Verify all examples and capabilities before launch.
Do not present proposed future services as included in the fixed website price without commercial confirmation.
Primary conversion is a free website mockup request.
Responsive priority: keep headings legible, preserve high-contrast CTA and stack cards.

build_acceptance_criteria: Visual match to approved screenshot at desktop, adapted sensibly to mobile.
Every section exists in specified order and is semantically structured.
Text is live accessible HTML and buttons are functional.
All unverified reviews, results and fictional case imagery are replaced or omitted.
Every supplied reference-only crop is replaced with production-quality asset or rebuilt as HTML/CSS.
Pricing and inclusions agree with current commercial offer.
Primary CTA navigates to actual free mockup request flow.
